items.text: Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, day-to-day per Harbaugh; status up in the air for Week 2 vs Raiders, monitored all week.
items.why: Left early or dinged in Week 1; imaging/monitoring.
items.implication: Hold but have handcuff ready; risky start.
items.opportunity: If out, boost to Quentin Johnston/Tre Harris/Derius Davis.

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring not serious, day-to-day; would have returned if playoff game; MRI pending but optimistic, coach confirms DTD.
items.why: Aggravated prior issue but not serious per sources.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, Bateman/Lane (but Lane also hurt) upside.

items.text: A.J. Brown high-ankle sprain, expected out ~6 weeks, placed on IR by Patriots.
items.why: MRI confirmed high ankle; multi-week absence.
items.implication: Drop or IR stash; free up roster.
items.opportunity: Boost to other NE pass catchers like Diggs/Henderson if back.

items.text: Malik Nabers listed with no news/pending then ruled ACTIVE late for Week 1 after questionable knee status post-ACL; played and produced 6/69 on 9 targets.
items.why: Game-time decision resolved positively; cleared and felt ready in warmups.
items.implication: Start as WR1; reverse any decoy/bench assumptions.
items.opportunity: Full route/target share expected going forward if healthy.

items.text: Alvin Kamara NOT EXPECTED TO PLAY (knee) for Week 1; confirmed impact on Saints backfield projections.
Lions offense extremely concentrated: Gibbs, ARSB, LaPorta, Jamo accounted for 65 of 70 offensive opportunities (93%). No RB2, no WR3 targets, no TE2 usage.
items.why: Post-game charting confirms hyper-concentration in good offense.
items.implication: Lock in the big 4; fade any Lions depth.
items.opportunity: Elite snap/route/target/carry shares for the four.

items.text: Bucky Irving 22.3 PPR overstated vs usage (8 carries, 21 routes, 7 targets all caught) but got sole RB carry inside 10, out-routed Gainwell 21-13, looked healthy; strong vs CLE next.
items.why: Goal-line work and route edge over handcuff despite modest volume.
items.implication: Start with confidence; Gainwell clear backup.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/red-zone and passing-down role secured if healthy.

items.text: Brock Bowers now considered day-to-day by Raiders HC after meniscus trim; working hard to return, short-term issue; Mayer filled in with 6 catches.
items.implication: Possible Week 2 or soon; stash Mayer as handcuff.

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate usage with Kamara out: snaps 53/26/15 Etienne/Miller/Donaldson; routes 24/5/7; opportunities 18/9/4. Committee persists.
items.why: Even without Kamara, split work with Miller and Donaldson.
items.implication: Etienne solid but not smash RB1; Miller handcuff/waiver value.
items.opportunity: Shared carries/routes; Kamara return would further dilute.
items.conflict: Some may still love Etienne as lead.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) EXPECTED TO PLAY and confirmed ACTIVE for Cardinals Week 1.
items.why: Weekend reports positive; team activated him.
items.implication: Risk/reward RB2 start; Berry starting everywhere.
items.opportunity: Lead back role if healthy enough.

items.text: Rome Odunze (calf) EXPECTED TO PLAY Week 1.
items.implication: Monitor but lean start in flex if volume there.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Deshaun Watson dropbacks; even after Dylan Sampson (knee) early exit, Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes.
items.implication: Limited upside as pass-catcher; more pure rusher.

items.text: Colston Loveland disappointing box score but 92% route participation; two almost-plays; buying low everywhere possible.
items.why: Elite route share despite quiet day; process over results.
items.conflict: Concern listed in recap but still buying.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout season well underway after strong Week 1 showing.
items.implication: Start/stream TE or flex; waiver priority if available.
items.opportunity: Increased targets with Ravens pass game.
